text: Figure 6.5: IPsec configuration model In addition, the senders and receivers of IP datagrams can determine the required protection for an IP packet according to IPsec security policies. These are rules that define how datagrams are processed that are received by a device. For example, security policies are used to decide if a particular packet needs to be dropped or needs to be processed by IPsec.
